objective: Find economically meaningful, robust relationships between US equities and liquidity without optimizing original S/p definitions to equities. Distinguish quantity, financing prices and policy expectations.
status: Fixed before new monthly regressions. Past markets and earlier tests were already inspected. Calendar-era checking is retrospective temporal validation, not a pristine holdout.

assets.SPASTT01USM661N: OECD US share price index, monthly average, historical NYSE basis; current constituent continuity unverified. Price index not total return.
assets.NASDAQCOM: Nasdaq Composite daily closes averaged within each calendar month with >=15 valid dates. Monthly-average index change, not month-end trading return.

candidates.scalar: Preserved midpoint scalar dollar contribution / initial same-Wednesday bankassets *100.
candidates.allocation: Preserved midpoint allocation dollar contribution / initial bankassets *100.
candidates.m2: 100log nominal M2 change. Do not alternately select real/nominal based on results.
candidates.loans: 100log change of monthly average TOTLL nominal bank loans/leases (>=3 Wednesday observations); not all bank credit.
candidates.credit_ease: Negative change in monthly average BAA10Y *100bp. Corporate financing/default-risk pricing; no stock-price input in the arithmetic. Not pure monetary liquidity or a quantity measure.
candidates.real_ease: Negative change in monthly mean DFII10 *100bp. Real discount-rate pricing; not money quantity.

not_adopted.EBP: Uses equity information in default-risk modelling, so not used as the primary independent monthly liquidity candidate. Prior EBP results preserved.
not_adopted.SOFR: Insufficient pre2020 history for long-era validation; do not weaken minimum sample merely to include it.
not_adopted.equity_conditioned_shocks: Do not use stock-sign-identified monetary shocks to independently prove the same stock-sign reaction.

measurement.formula: S=R+P, p=(R/S,P/S), midpoint dollars preserved; no asset-fitted aggregate weights.
measurement.contemporaneous: Observation-time alignment: quantity last common Wednesday<=calendar monthend, at most6days old; M2 exact observation month; loans average same-month Wednesdays; real/credit daily same-month means >=15days. No publication shift in contemporaneous pairs.
measurement.leading: Decision=calendar monthend. Quantity latest common Wednesday at least14 days earlier(max20d age). M2 monthly reference+45d<=decision(max100d age). Loans reference monthend+14d<=decision(max70d age). Rate/spread monthly mean reference+7d<=decision(max70d age). Each candidate change compares exactly h months earlier using the same availability rule. Record all source dates.
measurement.targets: 100log(stockmonthlyaverage_end/start); concurrent start=t-h,end=t; leading start=t,end=t+h. No missing-month compression.
measurement.lagged_stock: For fixed forecast models, AR predictor is hmonth index change ending at latest month whose monthend+45d<=decision(max100d age).

inference.simple: 6candidates x2assets x2horizons x2timings=48 univariate intercept OLS/HAC6 finite correction. Report Pearson, Spearman, beta95CI, R2, Holm48.
inference.eras: pre2020 where target_end<2020; post2020 where target_start and both source observation endpoints>=2020. Require>=36 pairs each. Report each era HAC and paired circular-block correlation95CI blocks6/12,2000draws seed20260907+block.
inference.meaningful_contemporaneous: Full Holm48<.05; abs(full Pearson)>=.20; matching nonzero Pearson and Spearman signs across full/pre/post; all full/pre/post HAC beta95CI and block6/12 rho95CI exclude0 in same direction; all three R2>=.01; all leave-one-calendar-year-out correlations same sign. This supports association only, not quantity causality or trading profits.
inference.meaningful_leading: Same stability summary; separately require actual expanding forecast gains before claiming useful prediction. A full-sample leading p-value is not forecast validation.
inference.families: Fixed four multivariate added-quantity block tests (2assets x2h) get Holm4. Also publish these48+4 against preserved52 tests plus2new policy alternatives when available (106 total). That tracked-family sensitivity does not correct all historical model choices.
inference.year_sensitivity: Drop every target calendar year once, no favorable omission selected as replacement result.

forecast.specification: Exactly4 models: baseline=intercept+lagged equity change+credit_ease+real_ease, augmented=baseline+scalar+allocation+m2+loans. Same intersection pairs and same training for both. No feature selection.
forecast.training: Expanding min60 eligible pairs; each prior target_end+60calendar days<=current decision; train-only standardization optional for numerical stability, no future fitting. Rank-deficient training skipped with reason. No clipping or posthoc removal.
forecast.inference: Mean squared error and incremental R2=1-MSE_aug/MSE_base. Paired stored-loss bootstrap2000 draws,blocks6/12months; report95% and Bonferroni98.75% CIs for four model comparisons. No full-refitting/vintage uncertainty.
forecast.unit: Predicted monthly-average price-index log change; no portfolio, dividends, transaction costs or CAGR.

limits: Latest revised histories; buffers are assumptions, not ALFRED point-in-time reconstruction.
Same-month stock/credit-price relation is not independent proof that reserve quantity caused stocks. Credit risk and shared macro news remain.
Original scalar/vector and earlier null/negative results remain unchanged.
The goal does not authorize finding p<.05 by indefinite indicator/horizon/sample search. All candidates and outcomes are retained.
